title: Ethiopian Dried Beef Firfir
community: All of Ethiopia — the quanta-enriched injera scramble
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Quanta Firfir — torn day-old injera tossed with crispy fried quanta (dried beef), kibbeh, and berbere. The most intensely flavoured firfir — the quanta adds extraordinary depth, chewiness, and concentrated beef flavour to the injera scramble.
longDesc: Quanta Firfir is the firfir that experienced Ethiopian food lovers crave most — the combination of the tangy injera with the intensely spiced, crispy quanta creates a breakfast or lunch of extraordinary complexity and satisfaction.
ingredients: 100g quanta (ETH048) — fried and broken into pieces
steps: Fry quanta in kibbeh until very crispy. Remove. Break into pieces.
In the same kibbeh: cook onion until golden.
Add torn injera. Toss to coat.
Add quanta pieces. Toss to combine.
chefTips: The quanta must be very crispy before adding to the injera.
The residual quanta flavour in the kibbeh is the secret.
cookingScience: Frying quanta in kibbeh extracts the Maillard compounds from the dried beef surface into the fat — the kibbeh then carries these compounds throughout the firfir as it coats the injera pieces.
sustainabilityTips: Uses both leftover injera and stored quanta — two preservation techniques combined.
culturalNote: Quanta Firfir is the breakfast of Ethiopian connoisseurs — the combination of three preservation traditions (fermented injera, dried quanta, kibbeh-clarified butter) into a single dish of extraordinary depth.
